::: {#exm-pre-activation}

#### The pre-activation of one digit

In @exm-activation-function, the first line printed holds the first 4 entries of the [pre-activation](#def-pre-activation) of the [hidden layer](#def-hidden-layer) of @exm-hidden-layer,
for the first test image,
and the second line holds the same entries of the hidden layer itself.

:::
